title: ISM 433 MHz: six devices across the 2.4 MHz
description: tools/scene_six.json, 6 s looped, tuner on 433.920 MHz: an EV1527 fob 9b37d (433.050 MHz, 330 deg), a LaCrosse TX141TH-Bv2 sensor 90 (434.182, 95), an Acurite 592TXR tower 12053 (433.442, 170), a Toyota TPMS 4e3a91c7 (FSK, 433.767, 30), a Fine Offset WH24 weather station 101 (FSK, 434.825, 250) and a PT2262 fob 0F1F0F1F (434.538, 210) - real framing and checks (repeats, checksum + parity, LFSR digest, CRC-8), 13 transmissions, some at the same moment on other frequencies (EV1527 + TX141TH, Acurite + Toyota, Acurite + WH24, PT2262 + Toyota). Expect six device talkers at those bearings.
